description:
Advances: ancora.gate

Wave 1 of ancora-gg8 (B1 in the investigation record; findings-B and the architecture decision are comments there). Root cause: missing_decision?/1 (lib/ancora/policy_files.ex:114-117) is two path-set membership checks over the diff — it cannot see that a governing decision already exists at base, so a correct diff cannot clear the finding except by a noise edit to an unrelated decision file. The corpus already carries real governance linkage the gate never consults: spec `decisions:` frontmatter (lib/ancora/schema/meta.ex:12) and ADR `affects:` resolution (lib/ancora/decision_parser/affects.ex).

Deliverable:
change/missing_decision is suppressed for a changed subject spec when, at HEAD, its `decisions:` frontmatter names an ADR that resolves in the current index AND that ADR's `affects:` names the subject (or a requirement/scenario id within it) back. The bidirectionality is load-bearing: a one-way `decisions:` reference would let a spec claim governance nobody granted. Frontmatter-less governance files (.spec/config.yml, .spec/AGENTS.md, .spec/README.md) keep the existing co-change rule unchanged. No new plumbing needed: ChangeAnalysis.findings/5 already receives the current index (per findings-B). The finding message for the still-firing case gains the second remedy: reference a governing ADR from the spec's `decisions:` frontmatter (with affects: naming the subject back), or add/change a decision file in the diff.

Spec delta (land in this same diff):
Edit the `ancora.gate.change_findings` statement: after the missing_decision sentence, add "except when the changed file is a subject spec whose `decisions:` frontmatter at HEAD names an ADR that resolves in the index and whose `affects:` names the subject or an id within it; governance files without frontmatter (`.spec/config.yml`, `.spec/AGENTS.md`, `.spec/README.md`) shall keep the co-change rule." Add two scenarios: `ancora.gate.scenario.governed_spec_change_clears` (spec changed, its decisions: names an accepted ADR whose affects: names the subject, no decision file in the diff → no missing_decision) and `ancora.gate.scenario.one_way_reference_does_not_clear` (spec's decisions: names an ADR whose affects: does NOT name the subject back → missing_decision fires).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged tests for both new scenarios; the existing governance_change_without_adr scenario must still pass (config.yml co-change unchanged).
- Behaviors to demonstrate: both new scenarios; a multi-stage-epic shape — second diff touching the same governed spec with no ADR change stays clear.
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale plus targeted files, and mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
  - Final tier: before IMPLEMENTED, full mix test plus mix spec.check --base <stage-base>, run-until-green.
  - Verifier tier: mix spec.check --base <stage-base> and targeted/--stale selections only; no full suite.
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface, with the proving test that exercises that production path
  - Fixture/sandbox hygiene: async-safe tmp-repo fixtures, no cross-test leakage
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable/config surface
  - Every conditional clause covered by a test
- Call-site Integration: no new callable surface; the check extends ChangeAnalysis.findings/5 on its existing gate call path.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/derive/**
- lib/ancora/severity.ex
- lib/ancora/output*.ex
- lib/ancora/finding.ex (no registry changes here)

Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/policy_files.ex
- lib/ancora/change_analysis.ex
- lib/ancora/decision_parser/** (read-side helpers only if needed for the affects back-reference)
- test/**
- .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md (the statement edit and scenarios above, plus acknowledgment edits for this stage's own changes only)

Out of Scope (intent):
- No "newly-added reference only" variant and no ADR staleness/status windows (declined on the epic)
- No weakening of the co-change rule for frontmatter-less governance files
- No new registry code — this changes when the existing code fires, not the vocabulary

Merge gate:
- [ ] Code compiles cleanly
- [ ] Tests listed above pass
- [ ] Spec verification passes
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket

ADVISORY before your final tier: your own diff is the live test of your fix

Your Spec delta edit to .spec/specs/ancora.gate.spec.md changes a governance file with no decision file in the diff. Under the old path-set-only rule that is change/missing_decision; under your implementation it must clear, because the governing ADR already exists at base: add `ancora.decision.field_friction_response` to the `decisions:` frontmatter list of ancora.gate.spec.md (its affects: names ancora.gate back, so the bidirectional check holds). Do NOT add a Spec-Ack trailer and do NOT touch .spec/config.yml or any ADR: if your `mix spec.check --base 9373ff49ea0ce4bbe0069f4961094eee28fc0e81` still reports change/missing_decision on ancora.gate.spec.md, your fix is not working on the real call path and the ticket is not done. A final-tier run red solely on change/missing_decision while you are still wiring the fix does not count against the 2-run cap.
Keep working; same session tag and log path.

title: missing_decision honors governing decisions referenced from spec frontmatter
